invariants.claim: A successful purchase occurs in Active before endTime with a nonzero recipient and positive count that fits remaining uint128 capacity.
Each purchase appends one nonempty interval [oldTotal+1,oldTotal+entryCount], advances ticket count once, and adds entryCount*1_000_000 to unsettledPot before receiver execution.
invariants.evidence: Raffle.sol L223-L235; RaffleConstants.sol L20-L21; ERC721.sol L287-L290.

invariants.claim: From fresh state, ticketCount <= totalEntries and historical ranges partition [1,totalEntries]; burns do not decrement lifetime counts or erase ranges.
Minting rejects known protocol destinations; receiver acceptance is checked only when recipient has code.
invariants.evidence: Raffle.sol L497-L502, L598-L604; ERC721.sol L263, L287-L290; ERC721Utils.sol L32-L47.

invariants.claim: Guarded raffle entrypoints cannot nest during payment or receiver execution; inherited ERC721 transfers remain callable, so final owner need not equal original recipient.

calls.propagates: Reject entered value 2, set it before the body, reset to 1 after; zero initial clone storage is accepted. ReentrancyGuard.sol L69-L73/L88-L118; StorageSlot.sol L93-L97.
Active must match stored status on every returning path; mismatch reverts. Raffle.sol L215/L573-L575.
Low-level call failure bubbles; success requires first output word 1 or empty returndata with code, otherwise wrapper reverts; no receipt proof. SafeERC20.sol L43-L47/L212-L244.

Assumes exact authorized token transfer; sends zero native value and forwards gas before accounting writes. Token may fail or attempt re-entry; protected entries reject. Raffle.sol L212/L223-L233; SafeERC20.sol L227-L239; IERC20.sol L69-L78.

Zero destination and existing ID revert; mint bypasses optional authorization with auth=0; ownership/balance and Transfer precede acceptance. Old-owner branch clears approval but is followed by _mint revert. ERC721.sol L146-L148/L216-L244/L259-L290/L383-L399; Raffle.sol L497-L502.
Reject explicit protocol addresses and implementation; consult registry only for code-bearing unmatched recipient. Raffle.sol L593-L604.
Return immutable implementation and registration mapping used by destination screen; registry written before escrow. RaffleFactory.sol L42/L54/L89-L91/L123-L128; Raffle.sol L601-L604.
Receiver operator equals buyEntries payer msg.sender. Context.sol L17-L19; ERC721.sol L289.
Code-less destination skips callback; code-bearing destination must return expected selector; wrong selector or callback revert aborts issuance. ERC721Utils.sol L25-L48.

Executes after all range/pot/count/ownership writes. Receiver may reject, re-enter, or transfer the ticket; acceptance does not establish end-of-call ownership. Raffle.sol L230-L236; ERC721.sol L115-L136/L279-L290; ERC721Utils.sol L32-L47.
